{{Top|leg}}
'''Briefing Room Seven''' was a briefing room on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], used to prepare [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]s for upcoming missions. The small room featured a 3D [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] map and auto-contour seats. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was briefed in this room in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[H. S'man|S'man]].<ref name="Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This room could be the room seen in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] game, but while Commander S'man runs the briefing in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'',<ref name="Strategy Guide" /> mission briefings are given by Admiral Ackbar in the game itself.<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
